title: Hex Drift
tagline: A six-sided tunnel at terminal velocity.
description: You are falling down a hexagonal shaft that keeps closing in. Roll the tunnel so the open face lines up before you reach it — and it keeps getting faster. WebGL, sixty frames a second, one very unforgiving corridor.
author: HexCave
controls: Arrow keys or A / D to roll
howToPlay: Roll the tunnel left and right so the gap lines up with you.
Every ring you pass makes the next one narrower and faster.
Touching a barrier ends the run. Distance is the score.
goal: Get as far down the shaft as you can. Distance is the score, and your best is kept.

1.1.0.notes: In-game coaching: short hints that appear where they are relevant and retire once you have got it.
